name: Bender
ethnicity_note: Ethnic composition from Transnistria's own 2004 census, as the en.wikipedia article 'Transnistria' tabulates it by district. Bender is administered by Transnistria and the 2024 Moldovan census did not count it; this is the breakaway authority's count, not Moldova's.

name: Transnistria

ethnicity.note: Not read: nothing publishes the left bank without Bender. The shares of Transnistria's six left-bank districts from its own 2004 census, combined weighted by the same table's 2025 populations, which assumes the districts' relative sizes have held since 2004. Breakaway authority's census; the 2024 Moldovan census did not count this territory.
